LESSON PLAN CRE ACTIVITES
 Week: Lesson:
 SCHOOL GRADE DATE TIME ROLL
 TWO
STRAND/THEME/TOPIC: CREATION
SUBSTRAND/SUB-THEME/SUB-TOPIC: Self-awareness
Specific lesson learning outcome.
By the end of the lesson, the learner should be to state what they like about themselves as God’s creation.
KEY INQUIRY QUESTION (s)
 What do you like most about yourself?
 Core competencies Values PCIs
  Critical thinking  Responsibility Self-awareness
  Problem solving  Love Self-esteem
  self-awareness  cooperation Critical thinking
  Friendship formation citizenship
LEARNING RESOURCES
Bible.
C.R.E activities Learner’s Book Grade 2 pg. 1.
C.R.E Activities Teacher’s Guide Grade 2 pg. 12-14.
ORGANIZATION OF LEARNING
Learners to work in pairs or groups.
INTRODUCTION
Learners to sing a familiar song.
LESSON DEVELOPMENT (Assessment as learning)
 Step 1: Help learners to build self-esteem by helping them appreciate themselves as God’s creation.
 Step 2: Educate learners on the importance of using body parts to serve the Lord.
 Step 3: Learners to read Genesis 1:26 and 2:7 .
 Step 4: Guide learners to through the activities and questions in the learner’s book
SUMMARY
Review the lesson and make summary.
CONCLUSION (Assessment of Learning)
Learners to recite Genesis 1:27
EXTENSION OF ACTIVITIES
Learners to visit a senior citizen to talk about different gender roles in the community.
REFLECTION ON THE LESSON/SELF-REMARKS

STRAND/THEME/TOPIC: CREATION
SUBSTRAND/SUB-THEME/SUB-TOPIC: My Family
Specific lesson learning outcome.
By the end of the lesson, the learner should be to identify members of the extended family to enhance a sense of
belonging.
KEY INQUIRY QUESTION (s)
 Who are the members in your extended family?
 Core competencies Values PCIs
  Critical thinking  Responsibility Self-awareness
  Problem solving  Love Self-esteem
  self-awareness  Respect Critical thinking
  Friendship formation citizenship
LEARNING RESOURCES
Bible
C.R.E activities Learner’s Book Grade 2 pg. 15-20.
C.R.E Activities Teacher’s Guide Grade 2 pg15-16.
ORGANIZATION OF LEARNING
Learners to work in pairs or groups.
INTRODUCTION
Learners to sing a familiar song.
LESSON DEVELOPMENT (Assessment as learning)
 Step 1: Learners to read Acts 10:2
 Step 2: Guide learners to name the family members in their extended family.
 Step 3: Learners to draw and colour members of their extended family.
SUMMARY
Review the lesson and make summary
CONCLUSION (Assessment of Learning)
Learners to recite Acts 10:2
EXTENSION OF ACTIVITIES
Learners to participate in family gathering and enquire from their parents, name of members of their extended
 family.

STRAND/THEME/TOPIC: CREATION
SUBSTRAND/SUB-THEME/SUB-TOPIC: CREATION OF THE SKY, SUN, MOON AND THE STARS.
Specific lesson learning outcome.
By the end of the lesson, the learner should be to recognize God as the creator of the sky, sun, moon and stars and
revere him.
KEY INQUIRY QUESTION (s)
 What do you see when you observe the sky?
 Core competencies Values PCIs
  Critical thinking  Responsibility Self-awareness
  Problem solving  Love Self-esteem
  self-awareness  Respect Critical thinking
  Friendship formation citizenship
LEARNING RESOURCES
Bible.
Glue.
Scissors.
C.R.E activities Learner’s Book Grade 2 pg. 21-27.
C.R.E Activities Teacher’s Guide Grade 2 pg17-18.
ORGANIZATION OF LEARNING
Learners to work in pairs or groups.
INTRODUCTION
Learners to sing a familiar song on creation.
LESSON DEVELOPMENT (Assessment as learning)
 Step 1: Learners to read Genesis 1:14-19.
 Step 2: Learners to observe the sky.
 Step 3: Guide learners in discussing the importance of creation.
SUMMARY
Review the lesson and make summary.
CONCLUSION (Assessment of Learning)
Learners to recite Genesis 1:16
EXTENSION OF ACTIVITIES
Learners to participate in observing the sky at night with the help of their parents.

 What do you see when you observe the sky?

Bible.
Glue.

Learners to work in pairs or groups.

Learners to sing a familiar song about the sky, moon and stars as God’s creation.

Learners to recite Genesis 1:16
